about: Output name (assets/sfx/voice/<name>.mp3) -> original clip id. The identification behind every row is in work/audio/VOICES.md. Entries may be {src, semitones} to lower the pitch (Mustapha's shouts are pitched down 6 semitones, to his eating voice V31, because the user heard them as female). Mess's main shout (-3) and Jack's jump shout (-2) are brought to within a semitone or two of their own eating voices too. enemy-grunt was V26, which matches Hannah's V21 (VOICES.md) and played on nearly every hit, so a fight sounded like a girl; it is now the male grunt V11 lowered 4 semitones. 2026-10-25, by the user's ear: Mustapha is V12 (-6), V09, V31 and V05 only (V23 is not him, V07 is not him: V07 is now Jack's win); V02 is not an enemy voice, so enemies use the male grunt V11 at -4 and -7.
